page.title: Edited files
page.subtitle: Files open in an external editor. Each save there is uploaded to the server.
page.subtitleMore: Closing the file in your editor does not stop syncing; use Stop editing. If your editor briefly says the file is in use, save again.
page.note: While you edit, a copy of each file is stored on this computer. Stop editing deletes it; your editor may keep its own copies (backups, history).
page.emptyText: Open a remote file from a Files tab: row menu (…) → Open in external editor, or Shift+Enter.

notice.text: Carapace downloads a copy of the file to this computer (only your account can read it), opens it in your editor and uploads it each time you save. The copy is deleted when you stop editing or quit. Your editor may keep its own copies, such as backups or history.
